issues.text: Run 1: wire the 3 devices as a daisy chain, one after another. Star and T connections are not allowed.
M1XIN "B" (address 5) uses zones 65-80, which this account has set as wireless. Move the expander or change the wireless zone groups.
With wireless in use, each hardwired expander at address 3 to 10 (zones 33-160) uses up one group of 16 wireless zones. 2 of those here: at most 112 wireless zones remain (up to 144 without any).
No device currents entered, so the power load was not checked. The +12V keypad output of the control is protected at 1.25 A; the hub adds 30 mA, plus 20 mA per branch for the M1DBHR.

checklist.title: Control
items: JP3 (terminating jumper on the M1 control): INSTALL it. With one run, the control end is the second of the two termination points.
The data bus must have exactly two terminating points in total, never more.

checklist.title: Run 1
items: Daisy chain: control → M1XRFTWM (address 2) → M1XIN "A" (address 3) → M1XIN "B" (address 5). About 50 ft.
Terminate the last device only: M1XIN "B" (address 5). Fit its terminating jumper. Do not terminate the others.

checklist.title: Addresses to set
items: M1XRFTWM (address 2): primary transceiver; S1 off, S2 on, S3 off, S4 off
M1XIN "A" (address 3): zones 33-48; S1 on, S2 on, S3 off, S4 off
M1XIN "B" (address 5): zones 65-80; S1 on, S2 off, S3 on, S4 off
After setting the addresses, run Bus Module Enrollment (installer programming, or Live > Modules in this editor). Devices added later must be enrolled too.
